shortDescription: A train derailed between Rouen and Caen in northern France, injuring around 20 people, the French transport minister Philippe Tabarot said in a post on X on Friday evening.The train was carrying 180 passengers and went of the rails near to the town of Cleon in Normandy, said Tabarot.
